name: geml
description: Preview, outline, hover, go-to-definition, rename, per-block revert, workspace search and live reference checking for GEML (.geml) documents.

commands.title: Revert Block to a Past Revision…

geml.check.enabled.description: Run `geml check` and show diagnostics (broken references, etc.) as you edit.

geml.check.path.description: How to invoke the GEML CLI: `geml` (found on PATH, never in the document's folder) or an absolute path, optionally followed by arguments, e.g. `node /abs/path/to/cli.js`. Package runners such as npx are refused: they would run whatever @geml/geml the opened folder's node_modules holds. Machine-scoped: cannot be overridden by workspace or folder settings.

enumDescriptions: Only the hosted server: the document's text is sent to `geml.mcp.url` with each call. Nothing is installed and nothing is stored there.
Only the local server: `geml mcp --root .`, one per workspace folder, reading and writing that folder and sending nothing anywhere. Needs the CLI and a trusted folder.
geml.mcp.servers.description: Which GEML MCP servers to offer chat. Offering one does not start it — the editor asks first. Machine-scoped: an opened folder cannot decide which server its documents would go to.
geml.mcp.servers.markdownDescription:
Which GEML MCP servers to offer chat. Offering one does not start it — the editor asks first.

The two differ in where the document is: the **hosted** server keeps no files, so the text travels in every call and a write comes back as the new text; the **local** server reads and writes one folder, and is the only one that serves block history and the code graph.

Machine-scoped: an opened folder cannot decide which server its documents would go to.

geml.mcp.url.description: The hosted MCP server's endpoint — change it to your own deployment of integrations/geml-mcp-worker. Must be https: every call carries the whole document, and workers.dev answers plain http with a 200 rather than a redirect. http is accepted only for localhost, which is `wrangler dev`. Machine-scoped, for the same reason as geml.check.path: an opened folder must not get to redirect your documents.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode only highlighting, the preview and the hosted MCP server work. Everything that runs the GEML CLI is off until the folder is trusted: diagnostics, outline, folding, hover, go to definition, rename, workspace symbols, copy block address or reference, revert block, save a revision, and the local MCP server.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run compile && npm run build:webview
